messages:
maya: deploy-bot reports prod rollout v2.18.0 complete at 2026-04-12T11:23:01Z

deploy-bot: [system] rollout complete: release=v2.18.0 target=prod status=success

qa-bot: starting post-deploy smoke: synth 'embed-quick' failing intermittently with 503 and occasional 30s timeouts. p95 -> 780ms in eu-west probes.

sre-ops: checking gateway traces now. seeing upstream 503s from inference-runtime with message "no ready workers". also kvcache miss spike.

eng-runtime: early signs point to shard warmup delay on quant variants after the new scheduler change. collecting traces.

maya: prefer route-level mitigation over rollback. propose pinning /v1/embed -> v2.17.9 for 40m soft hold, then run kernel traces.

sre-ops: agreed. deploy-bot, apply soft pin and hold further rollout actions for 40m.

deploy-bot: executing `redwoodctl routes pin --route /v1/embed --to-version v2.17.9 --soft --hold 40m`

deploy-bot: [success] pin applied. traffic shifted in ~7s.

qa-bot: after pin, 5 consecutive probes returned 200 and p95 dropped back to ~210ms. :white_check_mark:

eng-runtime: saving artifacts to INF-5012. will reproduce scheduler change against quant harness.

maya: decision: no full rollback; soft pin on embed route; open ticket INF-5012 assigned eng-runtime; monitor for 40m and run small 0.5% non-quant canary after 15m to validate fix.

sre-ops: will escalate to rollback if error_rate>0.4% or p95>600ms. channel open for updates.
